description: This Java source file is a test class for the HttpPublisherActor in the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of HTTP publishing, including request construction, acknowledgement handling, and response processing, specifically testing the interaction with HTTP endpoints when publishing messages or responses.
